info.name: RateHawk / ETG API (WorldOta APIv3) Booking Hotel Search API
Search Engine Results Page by region

items.docs: Preliminary search (SERP) for hotels with available accommodation within a region that matches the given search conditions.

info.name: Search Engine Results Page by hotel IDs

items.docs: Preliminary search (SERP) for a specific set of hotels by their identifiers matching the given search conditions.

info.name: Search Engine Results Page by geo coordinates

items.docs: Preliminary search (SERP) for hotels within a radius of the given latitude and longitude.
Hotel rates actualization for a single hotel. Should be requested only after the user has chosen the hotel; returns the up-to-date set of bookable rates with their book_hash values.
